subject: Human Evolution
title: The Piltdown Fraud
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Piltdown Fraud usable.

hook.text: In 1912, a skull found in England was hailed as the missing link—half human brain, half ape jaw.

buildup.text: Piltdown Man fit British pride: proof that humanity's big brain evolved in England, not Africa.

discovery.text: For 40 years it fooled the scientific world, diverting attention from real African discoveries.

twist.text: In 1953, fluorine tests proved the jaw was a modern orangutan's, chemically stained to look ancient.

climax.text: The forger was likely Charles Dawson, a local amateur collector hungry for fame.

punchline.text: The greatest fossil hoax delayed truth by decades.

quiz.question: What was Piltdown Man?
options: A deliberate forgery combining human and ape bones
